descriptive_concentration.warning: Ratios of signed net gaps include cancellation; not causal attribution or statistical importance.

limits: One fixed development source group per synthetic family; twins and controls are not independent replicates.
Route inputs already differ at base; training route and inference route are confounded.
Whole-answer teacher-forced NLL includes format/EOS; no numeric-value/step/answer token attribution is available.
No exact-match, output-length, free-generation, benchmark, judge, held-out confirmation or causal intervention result.
Post-hoc strata and leave-one-group-out descriptions do not select a winner, change a threshold, or justify significance.

reasoning_target_format.source_based_observation: Canonical JSON sorts keys, so present-reference fields are answer then steps.
reasoning_target_format.teacher_forcing: Later step tokens are conditioned on earlier gold answer tokens; whole-output NLL does not measure steps-before-answer generation.
